items.name: Potion of Healing
items.summary: Drink to heal 2d4 + 2. Drinking is an action (a bonus-action house rule is proposed in Rules_Scope §7).
items.verifyNote: Healing amount from Items.md; 50 gp price from memory.
items.howItWorks: Drink it (an action, or a bonus action for a rogue's Fast Hands), or pour it into an adjacent ally: they regain 2d4 + 2 HP. Outside fights, drink it from the Inventory.

items.name: Potion of Greater Healing
items.summary: Drink to heal 4d4 + 4. Appears from Act II.
items.howItWorks: Like a Potion of Healing, but stronger: 4d4 + 4 HP.

items.name: Deepdelver
items.summary: +1 to attack and damage rolls.
items.source: Ulric's sunken shrine, in an Ammarindar dwarf's tomb niche
items.howItWorks: A dwarven warhammer, magic (+1 to hit and damage). Wield it in a hand like any warhammer; it counts as magical against creatures that resist ordinary weapons.

items.name: Lysa's Locket
items.summary: While dying you stabilize at the start of your turn; healing from Hit Dice is doubled.

items.verifyNote: Name found in the DMG tables (✅); effect summarized from memory (Items.md CONFIRM LOCALLY).
items.howItWorks: Worn at the neck (needs attunement). If the wearer is dying, they stabilize by themselves at the start of their turn. Hit Dice spent in a short rest heal twice as much.

items.name: Ring of Warmth
items.summary: You resist cold damage.

items.howItWorks: Worn on a finger (needs attunement): the wearer resists cold damage, and never feels the mountain chill.
items.verifyNote: Name from the DMG; effect summarized from memory (Items.md CONFIRM LOCALLY). A hidden find (D27). The DMG ring also keeps you comfortable in deep cold; that part is flavor here [inferred].

items.verifyNote: Name from the DMG; effect summarized from memory (Items.md CONFIRM LOCALLY). A hidden find (D27). The DMG cloak also gives disadvantage to Perception checks to see you; that part isn't modeled [inferred].

items.name: Amulet of the Devout +1
items.summary: +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs.
items.howItWorks: Worn at the neck (needs a spellcaster's attunement): +1 to every spell attack roll and to the DC of your spells.
items.verifyNote: Name from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything; effect summarized from memory. The book limits it to clerics and paladins and adds an extra Channel Divinity; here any spellcaster can attune and the Channel Divinity part isn't modeled [inferred]. A hidden find (D27).

items.name: Ring of Resistance (fire)
